newsitem.title: USA: Ultra Pac not in default on long-term debt.
newsitem.headline: Ultra Pac not in default on long-term debt.

text.p: Ultra Pac Inc, which makes plastic food packaging, said Thursday it is no longer in default on any of its long-term debt obligations.
Ultra Pac said, as anticipated, it received in June from its principal lender an additional $2,600,000 under a new term note.

The company said it will be required to renew or refinance, prior to the expiration in May 1997, $1,625,000 of the new term note, plus up to $13,500,000 of its existing revolving credit facility and existing term note.

The company said it received a deferral from its equipment lenders of about $2,250,000 in principal payments due during fiscal 1997. In connection with this, Ultra Pac said it issued warrants, expiring June 2006, to the lenders to purchase 185,000 shares of common stock, exercisable at $3.00 a share.
